title: F1 25
summary: F1 25 only starts on a Mac through Swofty Launcher, a mod launcher you download yourself, and on NotProton it crashed half a minute in and Swofty could not find Steam. This asks you where your Swofty download is and copies it, keeps the game's memory where it does not crash, for this game alone, prepares the game's prefix and makes Steam's Play start the game through it. Offline, without EA AntiCheat or multiplayer. NotProton with CrossOver Preview 41303 (Rosetta) only. AT YOUR OWN RISK: MacGameFix does not answer for failures in the game, its saves or its mods.

credits.name: Swofty Launcher
credits.note: The mod launcher and the offline play that start the game. You download it from Swofty's site; the install asks where the download is and copies it. It is not part of MacGameFix, and MacGameFix does not download it.

excerpts.note: An allocation the game asks for with no address is first asked for below the area Wine 11.21 reserves near the top, with an address requirement; only when nothing is free there does the game's own request go through as it was.
NotProton's ntdll stays as it is: the library swaps the syscall table's four entries, all or none, inside F1 25's process only.
Swofty Launcher is the player's own download: the .zip, the unpacked folder or its swofty.exe. Whatever is given has to hold exactly one bin/swofty.exe with loader/ beside it, or nothing is changed.
Swofty reads ActiveUser to see that Steam is signed in. NotProton's Steam stub does not write it, so the account comes from Steam's own loginusers.vdf.
NotProton keeps a row's value as a variable in the launch options, in front of the script, so the script finds the three rows in its own environment.
Steam's Play hands NotProton EA AntiCheat's launcher; this hands it Swofty's command line instead, in the same prefix.

With Proton's variable set, Swofty starts the game through a proton script NotProton's tool does not have. Cleared, Swofty starts it itself. The first start asks the player for Swofty's offline play terms and does its one-time setup.

symptom: Steam's Play opens EA AntiCheat's launcher, which does not run on a Mac. Through Swofty Launcher on NotProton the game closed about half a minute after it started, at the main menu, and Swofty reported that Steam was not running.
cause: Three things. Wine 11.21 searches its reserved address areas bottom-up, and a 6.5 GB image fills the low one, so the game's objects landed at 0x7ff000000000 and up, and a pointer to a low object came back with bit 47 set (crash at F1_25.exe+0x416a797, four times of four). Swofty takes NotProton's STEAM_COMPAT_TOOL_PATHS for Proton's folder and starts the game with a proton script NotProton's tool does not have. And NotProton's Steam stub writes the running Steam's process but not ActiveUser, and its Steam folder has no loginusers.vdf, which is where Swofty looks for a signed-in Steam.
fix: MacGameFix's shared Engine fixes row has NotProton load mgf-engine.dylib, which arms in F1 25 alone a fix that asks allocations with no address below the high reserved area first, which is what engine patch 0038 does inside ntdll.so for every game, so the runner need not carry 0038. The fix copies the Swofty Launcher the player downloaded, writes the version override and ActiveUser into the prefix, links Steam's loginusers.vdf, depot manifests and content log into the prefix's Steam folder, and puts a script before %command% in Steam's launch options that starts Swofty's command line in place of EA AntiCheat's launcher, with STEAM_COMPAT_TOOL_PATHS cleared. MacGameFix's shared rows Start through the mod tool and Play opens switch it and choose what Play opens (the game, the game without mods, the game with Wine's exception notes, or the mod tool's window); a NotProton row cannot change the program Steam starts, so those rows are the switches the script reads, and nothing a player may set is typed into the launch options by hand. Played on 2026-11-23 from a clean prefix with patch 0038: the modded profile reached the menu and a race, the game's objects at 0x4.., 0x5.. and 0x6... Played on 2026-11-24 with 0038 switched off and the library loaded: a full race without the crash.
backend: D3DMetal. Ray tracing closed the game when it was turned on; it is left off.
crossover: CrossOver Preview 27 (27.0.0.41303), NotProton runner on Rosetta, 2026-11-23 and 2026-11-24
